title: Math olympiad
text:
A math olympiad is a mathematics competition on the highest level of prestige for pre-university students. Examples are RMO (India) for regional olympiads, CMO (China) for national olympiads, and IMO (Int'l) for international olympiads.

Regional and national olympiads are usually hosted for a route to the national team of an international olympiad, whether it be the EGMO, BxMO, IMO, RMM, etc.

Math olympiads test proof-writing and critical thinking within a time period, although the time period is usually a few hours.
